purpose: Control full-length 15-E mock construction from the official 2026-27 blueprint supplied to the project.
source_policy: The supplied official 2026-27 blueprint is authoritative for allocation. Do not replace missing source evidence with assumptions.

allocation.status: requires exact row-level values from the supplied board blueprint before activation

validation_pipeline: map every blueprint row to question type and marks
map approved bank questions to rows
important_design_rule: Do not silently manufacture a blueprint distribution. If the exact board row allocation is not available in machine-readable form, keep the assembler inactive and request/source the exact blueprint values.
